stem:
Multiple choice question: Meera's teacher asks the class how the water that Rohan pours at the roots of the money plant at home reaches its leaves. Which of the following statements is correct ( )
A. Water and minerals travel from the roots to the leaves through the phloem.
B. Water and minerals travel from the leaves down to the roots through the xylem.
C. Water and minerals are carried from the roots upward through the xylem to the leaves and other parts of the plant.
D. Water and minerals are carried by the xylem to the leaves only, and never reach the flowers.

options.text: Water and minerals travel from the roots to the leaves through the phloem
Water and minerals travel from the leaves down to the roots through the xylem
Water and minerals are carried from the roots upward through the xylem to the leaves and other parts of the plant
Water and minerals are carried by the xylem to the leaves only, and never reach the flowers

teacher.key_rationale: Xylem transports water and dissolved minerals absorbed by the roots upward to the leaves and all other plant parts, including stems and flowers. A wrongly names phloem, B reverses the direction, and D wrongly restricts delivery to leaves only.
